_note: Briefs for the 10 food guides written 2026-11-16. Every number: value, unit/basis, type (source, derived or assumption), source and URL, date checked. IFCT 2017 prints energy in kJ only; kcal = kJ / 4.184 is our conversion. USDA values were read from the SR Legacy (April 2018) and FNDDS 2021-2023 (31 Oct 2024) bulk CSV downloads on 2026-11-16 (FDC links point to the same ids); the two packaged biryani labels were read through the FDC search API. Items marked WEAK are the least well sourced.
